Row/column phase gauge reduces symbol to [[1,1],[1,e^{iν}]], and any gain >1 is strictly improved by pairing moduli and balancing the products; hence four input entry moduli must agree at every norming input. The remaining exact supremum is max_θ (3+cos(θ+ν))/(3+cos θ); the sharp inequality is 8k^2-2(9-c)k+8>=0 and largest root K(c). Equality fixes unique input cross phase ζ=(c-K-i sinν)/(3(K-1)); η=1 isometry endpoint, η=-1 gives fourth-power value 2. Small |ν| fourth-root expansion has coefficient 1/(8sqrt2). Independent phase maximization and witnesses checked for 6 angles.
